The '''''tarrada''''', also known as a '''tarrada cruiser''', was a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-equivalent [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. A number of cruisers were deployed at the [[First Battle of Vontor]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], they were used in the [[Second Battle of Balmorra]] and the [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kuat]].
